name: liquid-glass-music-card
title: Liquid Glass Music Card
description: A compact now-playing card with a spinning vinyl disc you can grab to scrub, a progress bar, rolling timestamps and previous, play and next buttons, optionally set on a frosted glass panel.
use: A page needs a self-contained music widget with a tactile disc and standard playback controls.
avoid: The glass refraction only renders in Chromium, and the card is capped at max-w-sm so it will not stretch wide.
a11y: Buttons and the seek slider have labels and keyboard control, but the vinyl disc itself only scrubs by pointer. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A small rounded panel, mildly transparent, holding a black vinyl disc with a bright printed centre label beside a five-bar level meter and the words Now Playing above a track title and artist. A thin orange progress bar and three round playback buttons sit below.
behaves: The record turns steadily at 33⅓ speed while the track plays; grabbing the disc and flicking it scrubs the song, and the timestamps roll over digit by digit. Play and pause spin the disc up or down, and next swaps in a new track.
customise: Tracks array, starting track, autoplay, one accent colour, glass effect and class name are props. The artwork variants and timing constants are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One card with a compositor-driven disc spin and a small meter loop; no canvas or WebGL.
